name: Zhejiang Tianyu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Tianyu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs in China and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs of anti-hypertensive, anti-allergic, anticancer, anti-fungal, anti-epileptic, anti-asthmatic, hypoglycemic, hypolipidemic, and anticoagulant series. It also provides fine chemicals and CDMO services. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
